name: Boon Of Skill
description: Prerequisite: Level 19+ You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: All-Around Adept
features.description: You gain proficiency in all skills.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose one skill in which you lack Expertise. You gain Expertise in that skill.
